pages.text: A heart, two iron ingots, three slimeballs and three stone bricks make this reusable station. It binds two ordinary Transport Slimes or two ordinary Combat Slimes. Both must have the same primary owner. Other professions and upper variants are unsupported.

Recover two living, healthy companions without temporary effects. Put their items in the slots, inspect both records and confirm Bind. Gear and cargo may stay. Original identities and individual growth remain separate inside one representative.

One representative follows one order and stores cargo in both bags. Damage and stamina use update both records. Activity alternates between members. Point upgrades and combat gear use member one; Creative stat edits affect both. Their point balances stay separate.

Recover the colony and insert it alone, then confirm Unbind. Two safe landing spaces are required. The original identities return in Wait with remaining health, stamina, gear and cargo. Cancelled spawns keep the colony. Recover a pending result at any bonding station.
